description.en: Collect ships from "Space Battleship Yamato 2199" in 1/1000 Scale!

description.ja: 1/1000スケールプラモデル ポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦 親衛隊カラーが登場！
description.en: 1/1000 Scale plastic model Polmeria class assault aircraft carrier SS color is now available!

description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト２１９９』より、航宙親衛艦隊所属のポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦を１／１０００スケールプラモデルで商品化。
description.en: From "Space Battleship Yamato 2199", the Polmeria class assault spacecraft carrier belonging to the Aerospace Guard fleet is commercialized as a 1/1000 scale plastic model.

description.ja: ● 親衛艦隊所属艦の濃紺の設定カラーを成形色で再現し、艦底下部の発光部はピンクのクリアパーツで再現。（※商品は発光しません）
description.en: - The dark blue setting color of the ship belonging to the Guard Fleet is reproduced with molded color, and the light emitting part at the bottom of the ship is reproduced with pink clear parts. (*The product does not emit light)

description.ja: ● 劇中シーン再現に欠かせない、親衛隊カラーのメカコレサイズのメランカが１機と、１／１０００スケールサイズのメランカが２機付属。
description.en: ● Includes one Mechakore-sized Melanka in SS colors and two 1/1000 Scale Melankas, which are essential for reproducing scenes from the movie.

description.ja: ● １／１０００ ポルメリア級強襲航宙母艦と、メカコレサイズのメランカには、専用の台座が付属。
description.en: ● The 1/1000 Polmeria class assault spacecraft carrier and the mechanical collection size Melanka come with special pedestals.
